_comment: Plan shader tag -> recipes.json key, for shaders whose recipe key still carries the source directory name instead of a compiled digest. `tools/reconcile_assets.py` uses this when the plan name cannot be matched by name (several profiles have more than one candidate, so guessing by prefix would be ambiguous). Only entries verified against a pass binding are listed; f04-31e9a53fa8dc (c256) is left out because its element count could not be matched to a source layout.
